description: This file defines classes and methods related to establishing SSL connections, including parameters for SSL sockets and the SSL connection job logic, within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: SSLSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for SSL socket connections, including connection type and proxy details.

classes.name: SSLConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing an SSL connection, including proxy handling and SSL handshake.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an SSLConnectJob instance.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the connection process.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates whether the SSL connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a sub-connection job.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of connection attempts made.

methods.name: IsSSLError
methods.description: Checks if the encountered error is SSL-related.

methods.name: HandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for SSL handshake, used in testing.

methods.name: ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of the connection attempt.
